chapters.script: Welcome to DoomLess AI, an AI-powered Apps for Your Life platform. Digital Nutrition Labels turn mindless scrolling into intentional digital habits.
Meet Maya. She opens Instagram to learn, but keeps scrolling because platforms maximize attention, not value.
Reddit users echo Maya's experience: losing hours, struggling to focus, and feeling exhausted after doomscrolling.
Current wellbeing apps tell us how long we've been scrolling. DoomLess asks a better question—was this content actually worth your attention?
DoomLess adds Digital Nutrition Labels to short-form content, showing people what they're about to consume before spending attention.
DoomLess scores learning, relevance, usefulness, emotional impact, efficiency, clickbait, and addiction risk—making attention measurable.
GPT-5.6 transforms available Reel context into simple, structured, explainable insights people can understand.
Chrome detects the active Reel, sends metadata through its service worker, and displays the cached AI score directly on Instagram.
Maya opens Instagram for something useful. DoomLess detects the Reel, analyzes it, and displays a Digital Nutrition Label.
Maya sees the Digital Nutrition Score, confidence, attention cost, and one clear decision: Watch, Save for Later, Entertainment, or Skip.
The score becomes a transparent choice. Maya can see why the Reel earned its rating before deciding whether it deserves her attention.
After repeated low-value Reels, DoomLess recognizes the pattern and gently asks whether Maya wants to exit the scrolling loop.
Maya exits scroll-bait and returns to conscious learning. Her summary shows useful content and estimated attention saved.
The dashboard carries that journey forward, tracking reclaimed focus, high-value content, healthier habits, and intentional behavior over time.
With Codex, we transformed an ambitious concept into a tested, working AI product within hackathon time.
DoomLess runs on desktop Instagram Reels. Next: YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and beyond.
We believe the future of digital wellbeing isn't about spending less time online—it's about making every minute online more meaningful.
Food changed with nutrition labels. The internet is next. Choose better content with DoomLess AI. Thank you.
